title: Token-slice provenance & layered-cache telemetry
creator: Ava Patel
description: Add runtime and ingestion telemetry to attribute latency and cost at token granularity while capturing layered cache outcomes (full prefix, partial prefix, KV hit, KV miss, stale-serve). Provide hashed token provenance linking emitted tokens back to request spans without storing raw PII, and build aggregation pipelines and dashboards for cost reconciliation and SLA analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Per-emission instrumentation: each emitted token (or emission slice) has a span/record with token_index, token_hash, emission_latency_ms, kv_cache_outcome (enum), kernel_ms, shard_routing, and parent_request_id.
KV cache outcomes distinguished: FULL_PREFIX_HIT, PARTIAL_PREFIX_HIT, KV_HIT, KV_STALE, KV_MISS and surface hit-level latency deltas.
Emission-level telemetry emitted to Kafka topic 'telemetry.token-slices.v1' with documented Avro/JSON schema; schema reviewed by infra and billing teams.
Privacy: token contents are never sent in plaintext; token_hash must use per-tenant salt + SHA256 and be irreversible in downstream stores.

End-to-end pipeline: messages consumed, aggregated into ClickHouse table with per-request rollups and per-model cost attribution; synthetic regression test shows attribution error <= 5% vs ground-truth simulator for 10k sampled requests.
Dashboards: latency-by-token-position, cache-impact waterfall, and per-model cost-per-token dashboard created and linked in the Console observability project.
Backfill: we can replay 7 days of raw event logs for a single example path to validate aggregation logic.
Canary rollout plan executed: 1% of traffic -> 10% -> 100% with fallbacks; rollback guard if ingestion errors > 0.5% or CPU impact on runtime > 5%.
Documentation: runtime telemetry spec and downstream schema docs published in Confluence and linked in PRs.
tasks: Design telemetry schema and enum for layered cache outcomes; review with infra/billing/security.
Add lightweight span tags and emission probe in serving runtime (C++/Rust) to emit per-token records asynchronously.
Implement per-tenant token hashing using KMS-managed salt rotation support.
Add Kafka producer with batching and backpressure safeguards; emit to 'telemetry.token-slices.v1'.
Create consumer job to validate, normalize, and write to ClickHouse (partitioned by date, tenant, model).
Build dashboard queries and panels in Grafana/Console for latency waterfall, cache-hit breakdown, and cost reconcilation charts.
Add end-to-end tests: unit tests for schema, integration tests for producer->consumer path, and load test at 50k emissions/sec sampling.
Run privacy review and threat model; add automated scrubber for any accidental token payloads.
Prepare rollout playbook and automated canary percentage escalation job.
implementation_notes: Event schema primary fields: tenant_id (string), request_id (string), model (string), model_variant (string), token_index (int as string), token_hash (string), emission_latency_ms (float as string), kernel_time_ms (float as string), kv_cache_outcome (string), kv_latency_ms (float as string), span_id (string), parent_span_id (string), timestamp_iso (string), sampling_rate (string)
Prefer emitting compact JSON to reduce Kafka bandwidth; keep max payload <= 1kb per record via token hashing and dropping raw token text.
Sampling: full tracing for first N tokens of a request and 0.1% random sampling for very long generations; collector must store sample_rate for accurate de-biasing in aggregation.
Runtime perf budget: adding emission probes must not increase p50 latency by >3ms for p99-sensitive routes; use off-thread batching and lock-free queues.

ClickHouse schema: table token_slices_v1 with columns date, tenant_id, model, model_variant, token_index, token_hash, emission_latency_ms, kv_outcome, kv_latency_ms, kernel_time_ms, request_id, shard_id; use TTL 90d then move to cold storage.
Billing reconciliation: consumer should compute tokens_counted vs billing_events and add a delta metric; if delta > 1% trigger alert.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Merge schema + runtime flags behind feature flag 'token_slice_telemetry' (dev only).
Phase 1: Canary on internal traffic (1% of requests, internal tenants) for 72h. Monitor CPU, memory, and Kafka lag.
Phase 2: 10% public traffic for 48h. Run reconciliation test with simulator for attribution accuracy.
Phase 3: 100% enabled with sampling defaults. Schedule backfill job for last 7 days for validation.
Rollback criteria: consumer processing errors > 0.5% for 30m OR runtime p95 latency regression > 10% OR Kafka backlog growth exceeding capacity.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: accidental leakage of token text -> Mitigation: enforce token_hash at runtime and PR check that rejects any telemetry payloads containing 'token_text' or similar fields.
Risk: increased runtime CPU/memory -> Mitigation: off-thread emission, bounded batching, and circuit-breaker flag to disable when CPU > 80%.
Risk: Kafka topic growth -> Mitigation: compacted topics for control messages, appropriate retention and compression, and sampling to limit volume.
Risk: billing attribution drift -> Mitigation: daily reconciliation job and alerting if delta > 1%; maintain simulator to reproduce edge cases.
